prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production character illustration for a Live2D game-streamer avatar. Input image 1 is a visual reference for the silver-white long hair, violet eyes, dark tall animal ears, purple flower hair ornament, and black/white/lavender fantasy clothing. Create a newly designed young adult female gaming streamer inspired by those features, with a distinct original costume and clear anime illustration. Front-facing neutral rigging-friendly waist-up portrait, head upright, both eyes fully visible, gentle confident smile with lips closed, symmetrical relaxed shoulders, arms at sides, hands outside frame. Elegant silver-white hair with separated side locks, violet eyes, tall dark rabbit-like ears entirely inside frame, one purple flower ornament, small discreet gaming headset integrated with ornament, black and white fitted high-collar top with violet trim and star pendant, tasteful fully covered chest. High-quality crisp anime linework, detailed polished cel shading, character-centered, plain genuinely transparent background with alpha, no checkerboard painted into image, no text, no logos, no extra characters, no props obscuring body. Leave generous margins around ears and hair. This is the base character artwork; keep the face and mouth clearly readable at a small streaming overlay size.

Edit the supplied newly generated avatar illustration. Preserve the exact character face, eyes, costume, colors and illustration quality. Change only the framing: zoom out enough so BOTH entire rabbit ears including both pointed tips are fully visible with at least 6 percent empty transparent margin above the tips and 5 percent around the sides of the long hair; waist-up framing, original illustration otherwise unchanged. The ears must not touch or cross the image boundary. Keep a truly transparent alpha background, no scenery, no text, no grid. Maintain the existing closed-mouth gentle smile and both eyes open. Intended as a game streamer character base image.

Create a production Live2D cut-parts atlas for the supplied character. This is an EDIT and technical separation of the same silver-haired, violet-eyed rabbit-eared gaming streamer, not a redesign. Preserve her anime linework, purple/black/white clothing, purple flower and headset. Output one high-resolution square PNG with a genuinely transparent background. Arrange exactly TWELVE separate isolated pieces in a clean 4-column by 3-row grid, one piece per cell, with generous transparent space between cells. There must be no text, no borders and no painted checkerboard. Row 1 left to right: (1) entire flowing back hair, from scalp to waist, only hair; (2) torso, neck, shoulders and both clothed arms/sleeves, NO head and NO hair, complete upper costume drawn under where hair used to cover it; (3) front-facing face skin oval with ears, eyebrows and small nose and neck, with NO eyes and NO mouth and NO hair, fill those areas naturally with skin for a rigging base; (4) front hair bangs and upper scalp only, NO face or eyes. Row 2 left to right: (5) the long left side hair lock; (6) the long right side hair lock; (7) both tall dark rabbit ears together with their bases, only ears; (8) purple flower hair ornament and black headset earpiece, only accessory. Row 3 left to right: (9) left open violet eye including white, iris, pupil and eyelashes, only eye; (10) right open violet eye including white, iris, pupil and eyelashes, only eye; (11) closed smiling lips, only lips; (12) a matching small open speaking mouth with a dark inner mouth, teeth and tongue, only mouth. Keep full pieces uncut and completely separated. The skin face, eyes and lips must be designed to align when assembled into the same front-facing face. Use the full grid cells to make pieces large and clean. No duplicated character portraits and no facial features in the hair cells. This is an exploded anatomical part sheet for a real Live2D Cubism rig.

Clean up this exact Live2D parts atlas. Preserve the exact position, size, design and content of EVERY part; do not move or resize anything. Remove ALL scattered blue, pink/magenta, white and gray background speckles, islands, halos and dirt around the pieces and in empty areas. The background must be COMPLETELY transparent with clean anti-aliased edges only at the actual silhouette. Preserve the white and lavender color INSIDE the silver hair and clothing. Empty space around every piece and between the 4 columns and 3 rows must have alpha=0. There must be no opaque background, no painted checkerboard, no blue or magenta background dots, and no outer white glow. This is cleanup of a transparent production atlas, not a new painting. Keep all twelve original pieces in their original grid locations.

Technical Live2D layer extraction from this reference character. Output ONLY her torso and both sleeved arms as a single isolated clothing/body layer, from the black high collar at the neck down to the waist. Preserve the EXACT black, white, lavender costume design, star pendants, off-shoulder sleeve decorations, buckles and chest proportions. Remove all hair, the entire head, rabbit ears, eyes, flower and headset. Complete the costume and shoulder skin naturally in regions previously hidden by the hair. The top outline must start at the black collar opening: do NOT include a disconnected skin neck stump above it. Both sleeves must be entirely visible and uncut, with generous empty margins. Front-facing symmetrical neutral rigging pose, no hands. Clean professional anime cel shading. Truly transparent alpha background. No other body parts, no isolated remnants outside the body, no border, no grid, no text.

Create a production Live2D expression layer for the same silver-haired violet-eyed anime girl shown in the references. Output ONLY one matching PAIR OF CLOSED EYES: left and right elegant curved dark purple-black closed eyelash lines, with her original thick outer eyelashes and delicate warm-purple eyelid shadow. No eyeballs, no irises, no white of the eyes, no eyebrows, NO FACE, no nose, no hair, no surrounding skin patch. Each eye must be a separate isolated curved eyelash shape with a large completely transparent gap between them; aligned horizontally and mirrored naturally as a relaxed gentle blink, not an angry expression. Place the two large shapes side by side across a wide transparent canvas with generous margins; no text or grid. Match the original character's linework and eyelash design. The rest of the PNG must be fully transparent alpha so these eyelid layers can be placed over the existing face base in Live2D Cubism.
